metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Asterworks Mobile (mobile operator); Platform: Microsoft Azure southeastasia (zones southeastasia-1/southeastasia-2/southeastasia-3); network range 10.250.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster asterw-prod-southe (AKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic billing-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer billing-rater, consumer usage-api; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
investigation_questions: Which host or node did the failure originate on? Give its hostname.
Give the IP address of the machine where the failure originated.
Which topic partition first reported the storage exception?
Which filesystem path ran out of space?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
Which change restored normal service? Provide its change identifier.
